name: Shemiramoth
title: Levitical musician in David's time
summary: Shemiramoth was a Levite who served as a musician and singer during King David's reign. He was appointed to play the harp and participate in worship before the ark of the covenant when it was brought to Jerusalem. He is also mentioned among the Levites who taught the people the law during King Jehoshaphat's reign.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as a musician before the ark
keyEvents.description: Shemiramoth was appointed by the heads of the Levites to be among the singers who would play instruments and sing with joy when the ark of the covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Played the harp at the ark
keyEvents.description: Shemiramoth was assigned to play the harp according to the Alamot tune before the ark of the Lord's covenant.

keyEvents.title: Regular service before the ark
keyEvents.description: After the ark was placed in the tent David had pitched for it, Shemiramoth was appointed to serve regularly with music and praise before the ark.

keyEvents.title: The Song of Praise to the Lord
keyEvents.description: Shemiramoth was among the Levites who participated in the praise when David entrusted a psalm of thanksgiving to Asaph and his brothers to give thanks to the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Teaching the Law under Jehoshaphat
keyEvents.description: A Levite named Shemiramoth was among those King Jehoshaphat sent out to teach the people the law of the Lord in the cities of Judah.
